Elastic Analysis of Deep Beam

Input data

Beam length - l = 4  m

Height - h = 2  m

Load - q = 100  kNm

Length of load - b = 0.8  m

Distance to load start - a = 1.6  m

Length of support - d = 0.4  m

Number of iterations - N = 21 

Original and Fourier functions for the load

Original and Fourier functions for the reaction in supports

Calculation of stresses

σx ( x; y )  = N∑n= 1Y2  ( n; y )  · sin ( α  ( n )  · x ) 

Plot for σx at x = l/2

Bottom value - σx (l2; 0 m) = 95.663737 kN ∕ m

Top value - σx (l2; h) = σx (4 m2; 2 m) = -147.56358 kN ∕ m

σy ( x; y )  = -N∑n= 1α  ( n ) 2 · Y  ( n; y )  · sin ( α  ( n )  · x ) 

Top value - σy (l2; h) = σy (4 m2; 2 m) = -92.320805 kN ∕ m

τxy ( x; y )  = -N∑n= 1α  ( n )  · Y1  ( n; y )  · cos ( α  ( n )  · x ) 

Value at 3/4 of span - τxy (3 · l4; h2) = τxy (3 · 4 m4; 2 m2) = 29.963833 kN ∕ m

σm ( x; y )  = 0.5 ·  ( σx  ( x; y )  + σy  ( x; y )  ) 

Δσ ( x; y )  = 0.5 ·    √  ( σx  ( x; y )  − σy  ( x; y )  ) 2 + 4 · τxy  ( x; y ) 2

σ1 ( x; y )  = σm  ( x; y )  + Δσ  ( x; y ) 

σ2 ( x; y )  = σm  ( x; y )  − Δσ  ( x; y )
